'''Spellcraft''' is one of the magic systems of the Willverse.

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Spellcraft is a magical system centered around the [[Aether]], which serves as both a medium and a source of power. Practitioners engage in fundamental skills such as [[Aetheric manipulation]] and [[Aether telekinesis]], with the latter being considered a basic skill. Manipulation of the [[Aether]] is achieved through the use of symbols and sigils, which can be traced by hand or appear as glowing markings. These sigils can serve various functions, such as providing alerts or appearing as swirling white discs during specific spells. Specialized techniques include pathfinding spells, which can visualize known routes, be linked to other individuals, and alert a user to enemies. Some spells manifest visually as glowing, twisting balls of nebulous energy. 

Magic is categorized into various specialties, such as [[elementalism]] and sealing and [[binding]] magic. Sealing magic is noted for being slower than [[elementalism]] and easier to resist using [[aura]]. Within the hierarchy of wizardry, an [[Archmage]] represents a specific level of power; these are human women capable of utilizing large-[[scale]] magic and understanding the sharing of [[Aetheric patterns]]. 

Aetheric phenomena can be massive in [[scale]], such as rituals that cause huge disruptions or twist the entire sky. Certain Aetheric formulas can even facilitate rebirth, allowing an individual to live two lives. The study and application of these forces are centered at the [[Magic Tower]], a vertical city and school housed in a polished [[steel]] spire.}}
